author: Animan
description:
10 most controversial anime that somehow aired on Japanese television — the ecchi, banned, and censored shows that pushed broadcast limits to the breaking point. This is Part 2 of our most-requested list, ranking the anime that terrified TV networks and still made it to air (one of them literally aired as a black screen).

From Keijo!!!!!!!! and Prison School to Redo of Healer, Yosuga no Sora, and Nukitashi — we break down HOW each one got past the censors, why the networks panicked, and which one pushed the line the furthest.

👇 Tell us in the comments: how many of these did you watch as they aired, and what did we leave off the list?

🔔 Subscribe for Part 3 and more anime deep-dives.
